title: The English copy
story: Mother goes to the municipality for English birth certificates. Told 'not possible now'. A clerk asks Tk 2,000 and says collect tomorrow. She bargains and pays Tk 1,000 to the clerk.
n: Medians from 105 paid and 45 asked reports.
device: First she is told it can't be done now. Then an employee quietly suggests she "give something" and come back tomorrow.

title: The testimonial
story: Maria asks for her SSC testimonial at the school office. The officer asks Tk 4,000. She objects. The head says the school runs on this money. She pays Tk 725 to the officer and waits through lunch.
n: Medians from 48 paid and 27 asked reports.
device: A clerk wanted Tk 500 for 3 or 4 sheets of paper. The principal said, almost openly, that the school runs on the money students give.

title: The first ID card
story: Maria applies for her national ID. First 'it won't happen', then 'talk to sir'. Sir never says a number but she understands he means Tk 11,500. She pays Tk 2,750 to be first in the serial. Card in 72 hours.
n: Medians from 90 paid and 56 asked reports.

title: The first passport
story: Passport refused three times over small faults. A broker outside quotes Tk 2,011. She pays Tk 2,500 in total. After that the same application has no faults.
n: Medians from 486 paid and 108 asked reports.
device: Refused three times for small reasons, until a dalal says Tk 1,500 will fix it. Dalals have their own code that they type where the applicant's email should go. At another office, a counter writes a number on a slip and sends people to a shop outside.

title: The driving licence
story: She passes every test but the result says fail. A broker asks Tk 4,750. She bargains and pays Tk 3,500. On the next date she gets 'pass' without sitting the test.
n: Medians from 310 paid and 86 asked reports.
device: A man points her to a "sir": Tk 500 or she fails. The officer warns about the CCTV and takes it under an envelope. In another report, an officer explains that a 100% pass rate can't be shown to the bosses, so the people who pay are logged as passed.

title: Giving birth
story: After a normal delivery in a government hospital, a nurse demands Tk 1,000. 'No payment, no help.' The family bargains and pays Tk 500 to the nurse.
n: Medians from 208 paid and 67 asked reports.
device: A tip at every handover: Tk 200 leaving the operating theatre, Tk 200 on the ward for "cleaning", then Tk 100 each time after.

title: The teacher's arrears
story: Maria, now a teacher, claims her increment arrears at the accounts office. Staff ask Tk 5,000 and send her back day after day. She pays Tk 4,500 and the bill moves.
n: Medians from 150 paid and 33 asked reports.

title: The trade licence
story: New paper required on every visit to the city corporation. Then a peon says Tk 12,000 and nothing else is needed. She pays Tk 3,000 to the peon, then the official fee. Licence next day.
n: Medians from 110 paid and 41 asked reports.

title: The shop meter
story: Her meter application is cancelled for 'distance'. The investigator sends her to an electrician who asks Tk 4,250. She pays Tk 5,500 in total. The meter is installed at the original spot.
n: Medians from 57 paid and 24 asked reports.

title: Land mutation
story: The mutation file sits six months. They ask Tk 12,000. She pays Tk 10,000 in steps: office assistant, tehsildar, kanungo, surveyor, and again at the hearing.
n: Medians from 479 paid and 289 asked reports.
device: A sweeper with a shop outside the land office steers people to his shop. He is not an official, but the office runs through him.

title: The mortgage registration
story: At the fingerprint step of the mortgage registration, Tk 12,000 is asked or the registration is cancelled. She bargains and pays Tk 2,000. She never learns what it was for.
n: Medians from 33 paid and 15 asked reports.
device: In another land registration, the broker agrees Tk 2.4 lakh. Hours later: "the government rate went up, Tk 20,000 more", then "the registrar needs Tk 20,000". She borrows from the seller to finish.

title: The police case
story: Police do not take her land-grab case. They ask Tk 20,000 across the visits. She pays Tk 3,000 and stops pursuing it.
n: Medians from 148 paid and 62 asked reports.
device: In another police report, a patrol stops the car and one officer goes shop to shop saying "the vehicle is waiting, go pay". The shopkeepers walk over and hand it in. One person is assigned to collect.

title: The family pension
story: Husband's family pension at the education office accounts. They ask Tk 62,500 in two asks. She pays Tk 20,000 and the work is still not done.
n: Medians from 90 paid and 26 asked reports.

title: Maria dies
story: Maria dies in the ICU. Ward boys will not hand over the body without payment. The family pays Tk 700 (one report). No median for this scene.
n: One report only, so there is no median.

title: The death certificate
story: At the councillor's office the family is asked Tk 2,000 for the death certificate, 'no other way'. They pay Tk 3,000 in cash.
n: Medians from 21 paid and 7 asked reports.
device: At the councillor's office: Tk 3,000 per form, "or it won't be done". Two forms, Tk 6,000 in cash.

title: The heirs' certificate
story: Her children apply for the heirs' certificate. A man visits the house to verify, then the administrative officer. They are asked Tk 2,000 in total and pay Tk 3,000: Tk 2,000 at home, Tk 1,000 at the office.
n: Medians from 21 paid and 7 asked reports.
device: In another inheritance report, Tk 50,000 is asked for the heir's mutation of a dead father's plot. Tk 15,000 is paid, and a month later nothing has happened.
